violated_contract: A long-lived worker must obtain managed credentials at request time from their owner, never retain a startup copy whose validity depends on a separate refresher. Beta v0.12.356 ran for about 15 hours: an offline refresh terminated the bridge timer, and pi-mono kept a stale Firebase token while app API requests succeeded. Bare HTTP 401 status code (no body) was untyped and invited futile resends.
canonical_prevention: Acquire owner-fenced headers for every HTTP attempt, refresh once on a managed pre-stream 401, classify numeric HTTP status before SDK stringification, and forbid startup credential environments and refresh-driven worker restarts. The interim request-scoped IPC must be replaced by a Swift HTTP relay for complete subprocess isolation.
